pages.text: Alloy Smelter upgrades enhance the machine's capabilities. There are three types of upgrades, each available in Tier 2 and Tier 3 versions.

pages.title: Capacity Upgrade T2
pages.text: Increases the smelter's internal energy storage capacity.

pages.title: Capacity Upgrade T3
pages.text: Greatly increases the smelter's energy storage capacity.

pages.title: Temperature Upgrade T2
pages.text: Increases the smelter's maximum operating temperature.

pages.title: Temperature Upgrade T3
pages.text: Greatly increases the smelter's maximum operating temperature.

pages.title: Efficiency Upgrade T3
pages.text: Greatly improves the smelter's energy efficiency.
